name: Rüzgârlı Sahil
scene: A kite flies above two wind turbines, a coastal hut and a bicycle beside sweeping wind and sea bands.
notes: Redrawn from grand_22 with lighthouse and hot-air-balloon design style references; target 110–160 panes. Visually inspected and regenerated once to remove the kite centre crossing, simplify its tail, improve alternating roof colours and provide a white exterior. Warm pair represents objects including sun rays and hut foundation; cool pair represents sky, sea and path. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists; some same-colour neighbouring subject panes may merge during tracing, crowded contacts remain around kite-tail attachment, turbine roots and bicycle assembly, and upper sun-ray/sky junctions need geometry review. Pane count and exact junction compliance are not certified at the design-sheet stage.
